protocol: Week 7 test split (500, seed 42, used once per pipeline); training 1,500 -> 1,200 fit / 300 validation (stratified, seed 42); every setting chosen on validation ROC AUC; fine-tuning repeated with 3 seeds
hardware: Apple M1 Max laptop, CPU only, 8 threads

whole.name: Frozen ESM-2, whole sequence, mean-pooled + logistic regression

nterm.name: Frozen ESM-2, first 100 residues, mean-pooled + logistic regression

finetune.head: EsmForSequenceClassification head on the <cls> token (dense + tanh + linear)
finetune.selection: learning rate and epoch with the best validation ROC AUC (seed 0); then seeds 0, 1, 2 at that learning rate, each stopped at its own best validation epoch

zero_shot.context: each position masked in turn within the full 110-residue precursor
zero_shot.score: masked marginal: log p(substitute) - log p(wild type) at the masked position; negative = the model finds the substitution less plausible than the wild type
